build_filter_pdb_files: build a pipeline that filters UniProt prediction archives by PDB association and extracts them with updated release dates
create_process_archive: create a function that extracts a gzip archive and updates its PDB revision date from associated mmCIF metadata
test_filter_pdb_files: test the filter_pdb_files function with sample archive and PDB directories and a UniProt-to-PDB mapping file
run_process_archive_with_timeout: run process_archive_with_timeout to extract and annotate a single UniProt prediction archive with a timeout
summarize_filter_pdb_files: summarize how filter_pdb_files reads a TSV mapping, filters archives by PDB association, and extracts them in parallel
